design_review_gate.feature_summary: M9 redesigns the history section of the UI from a confusing toggle to two distinct panels, and enriches each Entry in API responses with an AccountName field populated via SQL JOIN. Account History shows per-account transactions + audit (existing behaviour). Ledger Activity shows global paginated transactions (existing /api/transactions endpoint) with Load more. Frontend renders entries with the joined name; users can read 'DEBIT 100.0000 (Alice)' instead of a raw UUID. EXTERNAL system account appears as the literal name 'EXTERNAL'. No schema changes. Existing write-side test fixtures (InsertEntries call-sites) need zero changes — Go zero-value fills the new field. handlers_test.go has no Entry-field response assertions today; a new assertion for account_name will be added.

major_concerns.concern: Public API shape change: Entry gains AccountName field
major_concerns.detail: Every endpoint that returns transactions with entries inline (POST /api/transfers response, POST /api/transfers/{id}/reverse, POST /api/deposits, GET /api/accounts/{id}/transactions, GET /api/transactions, idempotency replay paths) will now include AccountName in each entry. Existing test assertions that compare full Entry objects must be updated. Verification confirmed: InsertEntries call-sites in integration_test.go use partial struct literals — Go zero-value handles the new field cleanly with no source change. handlers_test.go currently has no Entry-field response assertions; only a new assertion needs adding.
major_concerns.recommendation: Audit handlers_test.go, service_test.go, and store integration_test.go. Result: integration_test.go and service_test.go need zero changes. handlers_test.go needs one new assertion added (not an update). Minimal blast radius.

major_concerns.concern: listEntries called from four callsites — JOIN must be applied consistently via scanEntry
major_concerns.detail: Verified: listEntries (line 195) is called from 4 callsites (lines 121, 144, 185, 319). It delegates scan to scanEntry (line 242). Adding AccountName to the JOIN query and to scanEntry.Scan() propagates to all four callsites for free — no per-callsite change.
major_concerns.recommendation: Modify listEntries query to JOIN accounts. Modify scanEntry to add &e.AccountName as the 7th Scan target. Those two changes cover all entry-returning paths.

major_concerns.concern: Removing the toggle wiring may break tests that asserted on UI elements that no longer exist
major_concerns.detail: Verified: there is no frontend test suite. Dropping the toggle is safe.

minor_suggestions.suggestion: Frontend should render account names with element.textContent (XSS safety) — same pattern as existing render code.
Two panels should be visually distinct (border, heading) so users immediately understand they are separate sections.
Account History panel keeps existing 'Account dropdown + Load' pattern. Ledger Activity panel auto-loads first 50 transactions on page load and shows Load more.
When an operation succeeds (transfer/deposit/reverse), refresh BOTH panels: re-fetch the open per-account history (if any) AND reset Ledger Activity to offset 0 + re-fetch first page.
README API table should note that Entry now includes account_name.

api_contract_gaps.gap: Entry.AccountName is added to all entry-returning responses. This is technically a non-breaking additive change for clients that don't read the field, but a strict JSON-schema consumer might fail on unexpected fields.
api_contract_gaps.recommendation: Document in README API table. Acceptable for take-home — no real external consumers.

edge_cases_identified.expected_behavior: JOIN would return no row; entry is dropped from results. In our system accounts are never deleted, so this is theoretical. No special handling needed.
AccountName = 'EXTERNAL' (literal string from accounts.name). UI renders this literally — no special hiding.

edge_cases_identified.scenario: Idempotency replay returns existing transaction with entries
edge_cases_identified.expected_behavior: Entries returned via the replay path also get AccountName populated because they go through listEntries.

edge_cases_identified.scenario: Concurrent UI: user submits a transfer while Ledger Activity panel is showing offset=50
edge_cases_identified.expected_behavior: After mutation success, frontend resets Ledger Activity to offset=0 and re-fetches. The user sees the new transaction at the top of the list.

scope_guardrails.forbidden_files: Any file under migrations/, cmd/, internal/money/. internal/store/integration_test.go (write-side fixtures need zero change). internal/ledger/service_test.go (same — zero change). Any new file. The .dockerignore, Dockerfile, docker-compose.yml, .env.example.
forbidden_actions: Adding cursor pagination, account_id filter, or other features beyond the locked G1/G2 scope
Re-introducing any toggle / radio button / tab UI for the History panel
Storing AccountName in the entries table (it stays as a runtime JOIN — no schema change)

change_contract.concurrency_strategy: unchanged — read-only JOIN under READ COMMITTED; no locks required
change_contract.test_strategy: Verified: existing write-side Entry fixtures in integration_test.go use partial struct literals — Go zero-value fills AccountName, no source change needed. handlers_test.go has no current Entry-field response assertions; add one explicit assertion that account_name appears in a transfer-creation response. No new test files. Race check: JOIN is read-only under READ COMMITTED — race-clean by construction.
change_contract.rollback_strategy: Pure git revert. No DB schema, no new files, no new endpoints. AccountName field can be hidden by removing the JOIN clause and the Scan target from scanEntry.

ledger.Entry struct has AccountName string field

store.listEntries query JOINs accounts: SELECT e.id, e.transaction_id, e.account_id, e.direction, e.amount, e.created_at, a.name FROM entries e JOIN accounts a ON a.id = e.account_id WHERE e.transaction_id = $1 ORDER BY e.id
scanEntry Scan call gains &e.AccountName as the 7th target

All existing entry-returning paths (GetTransaction, GetTransactionByIdempotencyKey, ListTransactionsForAccount, ListTransactions) populate AccountName via the same listEntries -> scanEntry helper — no separate JOIN needed elsewhere
GET /api/transactions response includes account_name on each entry — verified by an updated assertion in handlers_test.go
POST /api/transfers response includes account_name on each entry — verified by a new assertion in handlers_test.go
Idempotency replay returns entries with AccountName populated
EXTERNAL system account entries show AccountName = 'EXTERNAL'

web/index.html has two distinct panels: 'Account History' (per-account dropdown + Load + transactions table + audit table) and 'Ledger Activity' (global paginated transactions + Load more)
web/app.js no longer references viewMode or toggle-related allOffset state
Ledger Activity panel auto-loads first 50 transactions on DOMContentLoaded (or page-init equivalent)
Successful mutation (transfer/deposit/reverse) refreshes BOTH panels — open per-account history (if any) AND Ledger Activity offset=0
Frontend renders each entry as 'DEBIT amount (AccountName)' / 'CREDIT amount (AccountName)' using element.textContent (XSS safe), no parseFloat

implementation_plan.action: Add AccountName string field to the Entry struct (line ~68). No JSON tag — matches existing PascalCase convention. ~1 line change.

Two sub-changes: (a) Replace the query constant inside listEntries (line ~197) with: SELECT e.id, e.transaction_id, e.account_id, e.direction, e.amount, e.created_at, a.name FROM entries e JOIN accounts a ON a.id = e.account_id WHERE e.transaction_id = $1 ORDER BY e.id. (b) In scanEntry (line 242), add &e.AccountName as the 7th argument to rows.Scan(). The JOIN never returns NULL since account_id is a NOT NULL FK. ~5 lines change total.

Add one new assertion to an existing transfer test (e.g. the happy-path transfer test) asserting that the response body contains account_name on each entry. No existing assertions need to be removed or rewritten — handlers_test.go currently asserts only on request body fields (dst_account_id), not on response Entry shape. ~10 lines added.

Remove the .view-toggle div (lines 102-111) and the standalone load-more-container div (lines 121-123). Rename the existing panel heading from 'Account History' to clarify it is per-account. Add a new 'Ledger Activity' section below the history-grid with its own table (id='all-txns-body') and Load more button. ~30-40 lines change (removes ~12, adds ~25).

Remove handleViewModeChange, viewMode, and toggle-attached allOffset state. Add Ledger Activity panel: on DOMContentLoaded fetch /api/transactions?limit=50 and render into #all-txns-body using element.textContent. Track a panel-local ledgerOffset variable. Wire Load more button to fetch next page with ledgerOffset += 50 and append rows; hide button when response.length < 50. Update each entry rendering call to display entry.AccountName in parentheses after the amount. Update post-mutation refresh logic to also reset ledgerOffset = 0 and re-fetch Ledger Activity first page. ~60 lines net change.
Remove .view-toggle and .toggle-option styles. Add styles for the two distinct panels (border, heading spacing). ~15 lines change.
Update API table to note that each entry includes account_name (string, account display name populated via JOIN). Update UI walkthrough to mention the two history panels. ~5-10 lines change.
